verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a full REST API for creating workflows, managing event sources, and subscriptions, plus TypeScript/Python/Java SDKs for the Connect API, an official CLI, and llms.txt for AI-native discovery — all first-party documented and probe-confirmed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration specifically of the REST API/SDK usage (community evidence covers general product use, not API-driven workflows).
